**Handoff written to [handoff.md](handoff.md).**

Root cause: `dep-4471` set `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true`. Pool of 20 hit `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`. Impact window: `02:14:18Z` to at least `03:59:27Z`. 530 requests failed. Roll back `dep-4471`.

```
02:12:00  dep-4471 starts, config reload
02:13:41  gen 119 applied
02:14:18  first 503
03:21:05  on-call paged, error rate 71%
03:59:27  last logged 503, still failing
```

Next: roll back on all 3 gateway nodes.
